From 89d030804831c4075496629343ae3bb3ae8ff58f Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Suraj Kandpal <suraj.kandpal@intel.com>
Date: Fri, 8 Mar 2024 21:19:40 +0530
Subject: [PATCH] drm/xe/hdcp: Fix condition for hdcp gsc cs requirement

Add condition for check of hdcp gsc cs requirement rather than
assuming gsc cs to always be required when xe is loaded. It is not
required for display version < 14

--v2
-Use display version in commit message [Lucas]

Fixes: 152f2df954d8 ("drm/xe/hdcp: Enable HDCP for XE")
Signed-off-by: Suraj Kandpal <suraj.kandpal@intel.com>
Acked-by: Jani Nikula <jani.nikula@intel.com>
Reviewed-by: Lucas De Marchi <lucas.demarchi@intel.com>
Signed-off-by: Uma Shankar <uma.shankar@intel.com>
Link: https://patchwork.freedesktop.org/patch/msgid/20240308154939.1940960-2-suraj.kandpal@intel.com

diff --git a/drivers/gpu/drm/xe/display/xe_hdcp_gsc.c b/drivers/gpu/drm/xe/display/xe_hdcp_gsc.c
index dcde1d0ac1f8..25c73602ef55 100644
--- a/drivers/gpu/drm/xe/display/xe_hdcp_gsc.c
+++ b/drivers/gpu/drm/xe/display/xe_hdcp_gsc.c
@@ -32,7 +32,7 @@ struct intel_hdcp_gsc_message {
 
 bool intel_hdcp_gsc_cs_required(struct xe_device *xe)
 {
-	return true;
+	return DISPLAY_VER(xe) >= 14;
 }
 
 bool intel_hdcp_gsc_check_status(struct xe_device *xe)
-- 
2.25.1

### Modifications in Each File

1. **File: `drivers/gpu/drm/xe/display/xe_hdcp_gsc.c`**
   - The function `intel_hdcp_gsc_cs_required` was modified to change its return value. 
   - The original implementation returned `true` unconditionally, indicating that the HDCP GSC CS (Graphics Security Controller Content Security) was always required.
   - The modified implementation now checks the display version using `DISPLAY_VER(xe)` and returns `true` only if the display version is 14 or higher. This change reflects that the HDCP GSC CS requirement is not necessary for display versions lower than 14.

### Relationships Between Modifications

The modification in `xe_hdcp_gsc.c` directly addresses a bug related to the HDCP GSC CS requirement by introducing a conditional check based on the display version. This change ensures that the system behaves correctly by not enforcing the HDCP GSC CS requirement for older display versions, thus improving compatibility and functionality. The patch is part of a broader effort to refine the HDCP implementation for the XE graphics architecture, as indicated by the fix reference to a previous commit.

Here is the commit message:
drm/xe/hdcp: Fix condition for hdcp gsc cs requirement

Add condition for check of hdcp gsc cs requirement rather than
assuming gsc cs to always be required when xe is loaded. It is not

-Use display version in commit message [Lucas]

Fixes: 152f2df954d8 ("drm/xe/hdcp: Enable HDCP for XE")
Signed-off-by: Suraj Kandpal <suraj.kandpal@intel.com>
Acked-by: Jani Nikula <jani.nikula@intel.com>
Reviewed-by: Lucas De Marchi <lucas.demarchi@intel.com>

Link: https://patchwork.freedesktop.org/patch/msgid/20240308154939.1940960-2-suraj.kandpal@intel.com

Here is the root cause:
The bug was caused by an unconditional return of `true` in the `intel_hdcp_gsc_cs_required` function, which incorrectly assumed that the HDCP GSC CS requirement was always necessary regardless of the display version. This led to compatibility issues for display versions lower than 14, where the requirement was not applicable.

Here is the patch:
 
 bool intel_hdcp_gsc_cs_required(struct xe_device *xe)
 {
-	return true;
+	return DISPLAY_VER(xe) >= 14;
 }

Reason:
This change introduces a conditional check that ensures the HDCP GSC CS requirement is only considered necessary for display versions 14 and above, thus resolving the compatibility issue for lower display versions.
